record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, increase tied item-embedding and matching hidden width from 48 to 52, propagating only required tensor-shape changes. Since widths 40 and 64 regressed, this tests a modest capacity increase near the incumbent without changing input/output sharing. Keep initialization scheme, features, causal block structure, history/readout, dot-product scoring, loss and optimizer fixed. Ensure checkpoint metadata and the predictor writer load width 52 consistently.

category_rationales.rationale: Test a modest increase from width 48 to 52 across all four category models. Existing dimension-dependent layers, checkpoint metadata and the embedded predictor propagate this width consistently while preserving tied embeddings, causal topology, scoring, loss and optimizer.
